release_body:
## Stability Release — Full Behavioral Audit

No new features in this release. Every part of the codebase was audited for behavioral bugs end-to-end; **29 real issues were found and fixed**, several of them critical, plus dead code removal.

### Critical fixes

- Camera and microphone permissions for websites (`getUserMedia`) never resolved — any site requesting camera/mic (video calls, WebRTC, voice input) would hang forever. **Fixed.**
- File uploads (`<input type="file">`) did nothing on any website — a system file picker is now implemented.
- The JavaScript bridge could silently break in **release builds only** (missing ProGuard/R8 keep rule) — including F-Droid builds — while working fine in debug, hiding the bug from normal testing.
- The back button could leave a blank white screen instead of showing the home page.

### Tab & browsing behavior fixes

- Background tabs could no longer corrupt the active tab's address bar, progress bar, bookmark icon, or trigger the wrong error/SSL dialog.
- The Home button (toolbar, remote/gamepad shortcut, and error screen) now actually navigates home instead of only showing the overlay.
- Fixed a crash-prone "zombie WebView" left on screen after deleting the active tab group.
- Fixed tab eviction using insertion order instead of true least-recently-used order.
- Fixed rare thumbnail/favicon mix-ups after closing or reordering tabs.
- Fixed a corrupted/empty saved session leaving the app with no WebView on cold start.

### Input fixes (gamepad / TV remote / keyboard)

- Gamepad/TV-remote/keyboard input is now responsive immediately after a cold start.
- Fixed the virtual cursor losing its movement bounds after rotating the device.
- Fixed certain gamepads' confirm button (`DPAD_CENTER`) ignoring the visible cursor position.
- Fixed "Find in Page" from the menu not opening the keyboard.

### Other fixes

- Download manager: fixed a connection leak, a service-stop race condition, and a Handler leak.
- Fixed Eruda console / custom JS injection failing on pages with attributes on `<head>`.
- Fixed custom JS containing a literal `</script>` breaking its own injection.
- Fixed "Desktop Mode" requiring an app restart to apply to already-open tabs.
- Removed dead code with zero usages anywhere in the project.

Full details in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/SANDRO00O/ConsoleFlow-mobile/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
